title: Relaunch and the Gathering of Five
description: The opening of the Volume 2 era, including the launch of Slingers, the Spider-Man relaunch, and the Gathering of Five storyline.

title: The New Status Quo
description: The Spider-Man titles settle into their new status quo through the rest of 1999, alongside Webspinners, Slingers, and supplemental stories.

title: Turn of the Millennium
description: The main Spider-Man titles continue into 2000 as Webspinners and Spider-Man Unlimited reach the end of their runs.

title: Death and Destiny
description: Summer and fall 2000, centered around the Spider-Man: Death and Destiny miniseries and the continuing Amazing Spider-Man and Peter Parker titles.

title: Green Goblin and Mysterio
description: Revenge of the Green Goblin leads into The Mysterio Manifesto as the ongoing Spider-Man titles move into 2001.

title: Lifeline and Daredevil
description: Spring and early summer 2001, featuring Spider-Man: Lifeline and the Daredevil/Spider-Man miniseries alongside the main titles.

title: The Thousand
description: The launch of Spider-Man's Tangled Web and its opening storyline, The Thousand.

title: Tangled Web
description: The anthology era continues through late 2001 and the first half of 2002 alongside Amazing Spider-Man and Peter Parker: Spider-Man.

title: A Summer of Spider-Man
description: A dense wave of 2002 miniseries including Quality of Life, Spider-Man: Blue, Get Kraven, and The Evil That Men Do.

title: Conclusions
description: Spider-Man: Blue and Get Kraven reach their conclusions while Spider-Man's Tangled Web approaches its final issue.

title: The Final Stretch
description: The final uninterrupted stretch of Amazing Spider-Man and Peter Parker: Spider-Man before the closing months of the Volume 2 era.

title: End of an Era
description: The final Volume 2 issues arrive alongside Venom, Spider-Man & Wolverine, and the launch of a new Spectacular Spider-Man series.
